opportunities.title: Fulbright All Disciplines Scholar Award to the USA
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK citizens (resident anywhere except the US), or Irish citizens normally resident in Northern Ireland, with a PhD in a relevant subject or equivalent professional degree/experience. Preference to those without extensive recent US experience.
opportunities.summary: Lecture and/or research in any discipline at any accredited US university as part of the Fulbright Visiting Scholar programme. Grant periods typically 3-6 months, with generous monthly stipends.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Elon University Scholar Award

amount.raw: Stipend: $5,000 per month; housing: private bedroom in The Isley International House at no cost

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK academics and professionals holding a PhD or equivalent professional degree/experience.
opportunities.summary: Allows academics and professionals to teach and pursue independent research in any subject area offered by Elon University, with a stipend, free housing, and full-time faculty equivalent university support.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Royal College of Surgeons of England Scholar Award

amount.raw: £2,275 per month, converted to dollars at prevailing rate; plus RCS grant to cover basic NHS salary costs up to resident doctor pay scale for up to 6 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK trainee Royal College of Surgeons of England members.
opportunities.summary: Allows UK trainee RCS England members to pursue research into a number of surgical areas at any accredited US higher education institution, for up to 6 months.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Rutgers University-Newark Scholar Award

amount.raw: Stipend: $5,000 per month; housing within Honors Living Learning Community; travel grant up to £1,500

opportunities.summary: Supports one scholar to spend a semester (4 months) at Rutgers University-Newark teaching and conducting research on issues of the contemporary urban environment as part of the Honors Living Learning Community.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Royal Society of Edinburgh Scholar Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK academics and professionals holding a PhD or equivalent professional degree/experience.
opportunities.summary: Lecture and/or research in any discipline at an accredited US university, as part of the Fulbright Visiting Scholar programme.

opportunities.title: Fulbright-National Archives Heritage Science Fellowship

amount.raw: Stipend to cover living expenses, settling-in costs, and professional development allowances; round-trip international travel; dependent allowance if applicable

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers and professionals (UK-based), with PhD or equivalent professional experience.
opportunities.summary: Allows researchers and professionals to conduct hands-on scientific research supporting the conservation and preservation of cultural and historic artifacts at the National Archives in Maryland. Runs 5-12 months beginning September 2027, with lab access and Fulbright network support.
